task_completion.description: Access the Nx Witness Web Admin or Client interface via the browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the Nx Witness login page or dashboard at https://localhost:7001.

task_completion.description: Create a new layout and name it 'Lobby POS Monitor'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A layout tab or settings field showing the text 'Lobby POS Monitor'.

task_completion.description: Add two instances of the 'Lobby Camera' to the layout side-by-side.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout workspace shows two video tiles, both labeled 'Lobby Camera'.

task_completion.description: Ensure the first view shows the full default zoom.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The first camera tile shows the entire wide-angle view of the lobby without digital magnification.

task_completion.description: Configure the second view with a digital zoom on the bottom-right quadrant.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The second camera tile shows a zoomed-in view of the bottom-right area (the counter). The zoom frame/ROI settings should reflect X: 0.5, Y: 0.5, W: 0.5, H: 0.5.
A 'Save' button is clicked, or a 'Layout saved' notification appears, or the layout persists in the resource tree.

integrity.description: The agent used the web/software GUI rather than just executing scripts in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on UI elements, and text entry into the Nx Witness web forms.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply run a single 'solve' script that bypasses the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows step-by-step navigation through the Nx Witness interface.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Nx Witness system at the specified URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar consistently shows https://localhost:7001 during the configuration process.
